notes: Flags: none. The chair mat for the rug-free office and the Vari layouts (F-66; back-bedroom f, g, h), in place of the clear plastic KOLON (ikea-44881100). "100% Moso bamboo" slats on "a felt backing featuring non-slip gripper dots" (the page doesn't say what the felt or the dots are made of); no PVC, TPE or EVA named, so plastic-free. Wipes clean; hard, so casters roll well, and it does nothing for sound. Other sizes on the page: 48 x 36 ($102.67), 52 x 44, 52 x 48, 57 x 55, 60 x 48, 72 x 48; with or without a lip. Delivery Tue Oct 27 (2026-10-25). rooms: back-bedroom, from the brief.
